description: Works out a restaurant's prime cost from the owner's own figures for one week or month, as the free prime cost calculator on restaurantdoctorai.com does: food and drink used plus labor, as a share of net sales, against the target for its type of restaurant, with what the points over or under are worth, food and labor each against their own range, and which to look at first. Takes net sales, food and drink purchases and wages, plus optional payroll taxes and benefits, stock counts and the owner's unpaid hours, in any currency; a figure that isn't sent is never counted as 0. Returns the calculator's result, how it was worked out, and a link that opens the calculator with the same figures filled in. The figures aren't stored; only an anonymous daily count of calculator runs is kept.

closingStock.description: Optional: stock at cost at the end of the period, counted on the same items the invoices cover. Used only with openingStock.

format.description: The type of restaurant, which sets the targets: prime cost, and the ranges for food and drink and for labor: quick_service = Quick service (Counter or kiosk, fast turnover); fast_casual = Fast casual (Order at the counter, food brought to the table); full_service = Full service / casual dining (Servers, moderate check); fine_dining = Fine dining (Chef-driven, higher check); bar_lounge = Bar, taproom or lounge (Drinks are about half of sales or more).

openingStock.description: Optional: stock at cost at the start of the period. Used only with closingStock: food and drink then becomes what was used, opening + purchases - closing.

ownerPay.description: Optional: when the owner works in the restaurant without a salary, what they'd pay someone to do their hours, plus the payroll taxes on it. It's a second figure; the main one stays as the books have it.

payrollCosts.description: Optional: the employer's payroll taxes and benefits for the period, such as health insurance or a pension, when the wages figure leaves them out.

period.description: Whether every figure covers one week or one month, the same dates for all of them. Sets how a year is worked out (52 weeks or 12 months).

purchases.description: Food and drink supplier invoices for the same dates, added up by delivery date, minus credits. No packaging. Required.

sales.description: Net sales for the period, in the owner's own currency like every figure here, from the POS sales summary: after discounts and comps, before tax and tips, with any service charge paid out to staff added back. Required, and more than 0.

wages.description: Every wage and salary for the same dates, from payroll, managers included (a salary counts as a 52nd of a year for a week, a 12th for a month). No tips, but a service charge paid to staff stays in. Required.

name: restaurantdoctor_prime_cost

checks.description: Figures that look like a slip, as the page flags them. They don't block the result.

figures.description: In the currency of the figures sent.

foodAndDrink.description: Used: opening + purchases - closing with both stock counts, else purchases.

labor.description: Wages plus payroll taxes and benefits.

band.description: Under the range reads as fine, as long as every invoice or pay period is in.

range.description: Its range for this type of restaurant, % of net sales.

anyOf.description: The guide the result points to.

band.description: Under the range reads as fine, as long as every invoice or pay period is in.

range.description: Its range for this type of restaurant, % of net sales.

anyOf.description: What's left after prime cost, for rent and everything else.

link.description: Opens the calculator on the website with these figures filled in.

anyOf.description: The money over the target, a period and a year, rounded as the page shows it.

pointValue.description: One point of prime cost (1% of net sales), a period and a year, rounded as the page shows it.

points.description: Points over the target, or to spare under it; 0 right at it.

primeCostPct.description: Food and drink used plus labor, % of net sales, one decimal.

result.description: The result in the page's words, in its order.

standing.description: Against the target, on the share as shown.

target.description: The prime cost ceiling for this type of restaurant, % of net sales.

anyOf.description: Prime cost with the owner's unpaid hours counted.

workedOut.description: How it was worked out, with the figures in each step.
